payload.rebuttal: fixed: Section D's bottom layer (D-BOT3) had exactly one commit, so its diff_base and its current head's own parent were the same commit, making the wrong version's head^..head range byte-identical to the correct diff_base..head range. I added a second commit to D-BOT3 after the layer's push, which makes diff_base (base_sha) differ from the moved head's own parent (d_b1), and asserted the join's diff still shows d_b1's own change, which the wrong range would drop.
